title: Binaural Beats
short_description: Binaural and isochronic beats to relax, focus or sleep.

guides.title: Binaural Beat Frequency Calculator and Formula
guides.description: Work out the left and right tone for any binaural beat with one formula, a worked example and a small calculator. Includes how a beat glides over time.

guides.title: Brainwave Frequency Chart: Delta, Theta, Alpha, Beta, Gamma
guides.description: A chart of the five brainwave bands in Hz, what each is usually linked to, and which beat rates to use when you listen to binaural beats.
